anomaly_label: Decreased distillate flow to distillate receiver (V003)

evidence.observation: System pressure dropped from ~500 mbar to ~255 mbar over k=10-13, then re-stabilized at ~300 mbar, a new setpoint far from the original 500 mbar.
Transient spike to 18.6 mbar at k=10 during the pressure excursion, then settles slightly negative (~-0.1 to -0.4).
Reboiler temperature fell 70.7 -> 56.4 °C with the pressure drop and only partially recovered to 60.5 °C, consistent with boiling-point shift at lower pressure.
Distillate and reflux flows essentially zero (0.0-0.2) after the excursion; no product take-off.

args.missing_evidence: Whether the pressure change was a commanded setpoint change (control/recipe log) or an uncontrolled loss of vacuum control; also a composition/GC sample of distillate and bottoms.
